information.description:
Adepts are bladedancers working their way up the Tyger’s ranks with little sense of self-preservation and solid skill. They’re often gifted cyberware for their achievements by various Tyger Claw mentors and masters, which only makes them even more deadly.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Tyger Claws).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
A cybernetical replacement arm. Comes with a free hand.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

This revolutionary design from Biodyne takes decades-old climbing gloves and scales them down to fit into the user’s palms and fingers! Who needs grip feet when you can stick to walls like a superhero?

Cyberhand Option. Requires two Cyberhands and must be paired. Negates the normal movement penalty for climbing, but only when climbing a wall or similar near-vertical surface. If the user also has paired Grip Feet, then when they use the Run Action while climbing such a surface, their movement increases by 6m/yds.

NOTE: This is vaguely based on a specific shard in Cyberpunk 2077 which mentions it.

Type: Cyberarm
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).

Single-optic Cybereye visor that takes the place of two meat eyes. Too large for a MultiOptic Mount.

Cybereye Options are always "paired" even if there is only one of each type. Penalties from Lost Eye Critical Injury are doubled if the target solely relies on the Monovision for sight.

Borgware.
Must be paired. Ignore any vision penalties due to lighting or fog/smoke.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

Run the edge at top speed, choomba. There ain’t another way to live.

Speedware. As an Action, the user may activate this cyberware, after which it remains active for the next 60 seconds (20 Rounds). While active, this cyberware provides a +3 bonus to any Initiative Roll made. If activated while the user is already in an Initiative Queue, their current Initiative increases by 3, which is lost if this cyberware deactivates or its duration expires during combat. This cyberware has a 1 hour cooldown before it can be activated again. Only 1 piece of Speedware can be installed at a time.

Type: Neuralware
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • Replaces the core system's Sandevistan; use this one instead of the core item.
  • Matches the core item's setup: the +3 shows as a toggle in the initiative roll dialog.

Deals no Damage. Fills a 10m/yd x 10m/yd with smoke for 1 minute. Tasks obscured by smoke have a -4 penalty.
